data.fund_type: Multi Cap Fund - An open ended equity scheme investing across large cap, mid cap, small cap stocks
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to achieve long term capital appreciation by investing in equity and equity related instruments of large, mid and small cap companies. However, there is no assurance that the Investment Objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related instruments of Large Cap Companies#: 25% - 50% of net assets, Equity & Equity Related Instruments of Mid Cap Companies#: 25% - 50% of net assets, Equity & Equity Related Instruments of Small Cap Companies#: 25% - 50% of net assets, Debt and Money Market Instruments: 0% - 25% of net assets, Units issued by InvITs: 0% - 10% of net assets. #In accordance with SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/IMD/DF3/CIR/P/2017/114 dated October 6, 2017, as amended from time to time, Large Cap, Mid Cap and Small Cap are defined as follows: • Large Cap: 1st -100th company in terms of full market capitalization • Mid Cap: 101st - 250th company in terms of full market capitalization • Small Cap: 251st company onwards in terms of full market capitalization Please refer the Scheme Information Document for complete details.
data.fund_managers: FM 1 - Mr. Harshad Patwardhan, FM 2 - Mr. Sanjay Bembalkar
data.exit_load: 1% if units are redeemed or switched out on or before completion of 15 days from the date of allotment. Nil if redeemed or switched out after completion of 15 days from the date of allotment of units
